info.title: EOSC Marketplace API
info.description:
REST API of the EOSC Marketplace. The API has these parts:

- Offering (`/api/v1/resources`): the offers of the resources that a user administers.
- Ordering (`/api/v1/oms`): the integration of an Order Management System with the ordering process.
- ESS (`/api/v1/ess`): the collections that the Search Service reads.
- Users (`/api/v1/users`): the user configuration for external clients.
- Search (`/api/v1/search`): the search and the filters of the services.
- Catalogue (`/api/v1/catalogue`): the public catalogue of the services. Only the pl variant has this part.

get.description: Search and filter services using Elasticsearch with EID-based filtering. Supports full-text search and multiple filter criteria.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query string. Searches in service name, description, offer names, and provider names using Elasticsearch

parameters.name: scientific_domains
parameters.description: Array of scientific domain EIDs to filter by. Use external IDs (EIDs) from scientific domain vocabulary

parameters.name: providers
parameters.description: Array of provider EIDs to filter by. Use external IDs (EIDs) from provider registry

parameters.name: jurisdiction
parameters.description: Array of jurisdiction EIDs to filter by

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Array of tag EIDs to filter by. Use external IDs (EIDs) from tag vocabulary

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Filter by minimum rating (1-5). Shows services with rating equal or higher than specified value

parameters.name: order_type
parameters.description:
Filter by order type. Determines how the service can be accessed:
 * `open_access` 
 * `fully_open_access` 
 * `order_required` 
 * `other`

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination. Must be a positive integer

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of results per page. Maximum allowed is 100

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order for results. Default is by relevance score
